quest.title: Bantan Sango Case File: The Truth (Just About) Comes to Light
quest.description: Ryuuji seems to have gotten further leads and must investigate once more...

talks.objective: Go to Bantan Sango Detective Agency

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Oh, you're right on cue.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I just finished scouting out several suspicious spots.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: One of those encampments is guarded by the "Top"...

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Ahem. I mean, by "Black Shadow." If you've got no other questions...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: As for yesterday's investigations...

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: As for that, I don't know anything at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!? Didn't Sango get you to go investigate?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: She did, yes, but... How should I put it?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: For example, "some overripe Lavender Melons" and "muddy hand-prints on a door" don't connect meaningfully in my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: But for Sango, these are the materials she needs to unlock mysteries as complex as "yosegizaiku."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Some overripe Lavender Melons" and "muddy hand-prints on a door"... How are these related, actually?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I'm just using an analogy. At her direction, I investigated some locations in Yashiori Island and Chinju Forest before reporting what I had seen back to her.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: As for any conclusions she might have drawn from my reports, only she knows what they are.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: To be honest, only Shikanoin is able to keep up with her train of thought...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shikanoin?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Someone from the Tenryou Commission. We had the privilege of making his acquaintance on a previous case.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: He's a rather... unique character. You'll know what I mean should you ever meet him.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Well then. The animals are in your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's still thinking about those "overripe Lavender Melons"...

talks.objective: Go to the investigation site and perform the rescue
Go to the investigation site and perform the rescue

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Ah. Wonderful! This should be all of them now...

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: ...Wait. Why *isn't* it all of them?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh... Why does Paimon feel like this is just dragging out?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: It is true that resolving cases sometimes requires a great deal of patience. Going the wrong way could end with you finding nothing at all.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: We have found a great deal of these little animals, so we are at least headed in the right direction.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: We might just have missed a few clues along the way or left a few locations un-searched, thus leading to our current impasse. It will be a temporary one, I believe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, Paimon gets it! You're saying that we'll need a bit of boom shaka-laka to finally clear this up!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Mm, yes, you could say that we are presently boom shaka-lacking. But not by much, I would say — we have been making great progress thanks to the two of you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That makes a ton of sense, Ryuuji!

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: You flatter me. This is merely experience talking.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: The further down the truth is buried, the more value there is in uncovering it.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: It's just a shame that we don't have any additional information at the moment. Hmm...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I suppose I'll simply report our present status to Sango.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: She should be able to consider some angles that haven't come to mind yet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure! Paimon has faith in your good sense, after all!

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Then it's decided. Let's meet at the usual place once more clues emerge.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: If I am otherwise occupied at the time, you can just look for Sango directly.

choices.text: (It feels like he already understands you pretty well, Paimon...)

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I will continue to investigate "Black Shadow." The matter of the small animals is yours to resolve.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I've already made some initial deductions. Ryuuji will continue to investigate "Black Shadow," while you will focus on rescuing those animals.
